entries.not_relevant_because: The bullet's list is the commutative-ring conjectures (zero divisor theorem, Bass's question, intersection and new intersection theorems, direct summand, canonical element, balanced big Cohen–Macaulay modules, Serre's multiplicity conjectures, small Cohen–Macaulay modules, and related). Both manuscripts, 'An explicit counterexample to the Auslander-Reiten conjecture' and 'A counterexample to Tachikawa's second conjecture', work with finite-dimensional, noncommutative algebras over the characteristic-two field F₂(q,H₁,H₂) in the Artin-algebra setting. The Auslander-Reiten manuscript says of its construction that 'the commutative restriction is not resolved by either construction', and none of the listed commutative problems is addressed. The Artin-algebra forms of the Auslander-Reiten, Tachikawa and Nakayama conjectures are a different target, not this commutative bullet.
